Third-party software statically linked into av2_mux.exe
=======================================================

av2_mux.exe is built from av2-tools commit ffbcb39 (see README.txt, LICENSE, PATENTS)
with the libraries below. They come from the FetchContent dependencies of that
checkout (CMakeLists.txt); the commit in each entry is the checkout that was used
to take the license text. Each license text below is copied verbatim from that checkout.
